[engine] Quote a throughput delta only as the paired per-rep median of an INTERLEAVED A/B with >=3 rounds, with the build fingerprint pinned and the md5 set printed next to the number.

**class**: `measurement-hygiene`

## 為什麼（because）

A single round of CGC_SUBMIT_AHEAD measured x1.78. The interleaved x3 run measured x1.711 (range 1.327-1.924) and the md5 differed on EVERY rep, so the single round was not merely imprecise, it was not quotable at all.

eng-20260915-192032-p25-submit-ahead-r1
